pl_ajustes_bluetooth_ayuda: Open Settings on your smartphone and go to Bluetooth.
pl_ajustes_permisos_ayuda: Open Settings on your smartphone and grant permissions to {{app}}.
pl_biometria_fallida: Your identity could not be verified. Please try again.
pl_biometria_fallida_opcion: Your identity could not be verified. Please try again or turn this preference off.
pl_bloqueo_sin_metodo: This smartphone has no fingerprint, PIN or pattern set up. Set one up in the smartphone settings.
pl_borrar_datos_error: The data could not be deleted. Please try again.
pl_borrar_datos_mensaje: Your name, the paired device, your preferences and all other app data will be deleted, and the app will start over from the beginning. This action cannot be undone.
pl_bt_apagado_inicio_mensaje: {{app}} needs Bluetooth to be on. Do you want the app to turn it on, or would you rather do it from the smartphone settings?
pl_bt_apagado_mensaje: Please turn Bluetooth on to look for your {{app}}.
pl_bt_no_disponible_mensaje:
This app has no access to Bluetooth. In order to use it, please check the following:

1. That your smartphone has Bluetooth and that it is turned on.
2. That the app has permission to use Bluetooth and nearby devices. You can grant it from the smartphone settings.
3. That your Pocket Locker is turned on and close to you.

Once these checks have been made, press “Exit” to close the app completely and open it again. You may also press “Settings” to open the smartphone settings.
pl_buscar_ayuda: These are the Bluetooth devices we have found around you. Select your {{app}} from the list to pair it with this app.
pl_detectado_mensaje: We found “{{dispositivo}}”. If you pair it, the app will connect to it over Bluetooth and you will be able to manage your access from this smartphone.
pl_error_apertura_mensaje: The command could not be sent to your {{app}}. Please try again.
pl_error_conexion_mensaje: Could not connect to your {{app}}. Make sure it is on and close to you.
pl_error_emparejar: The device could not be paired.
pl_error_inesperado: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
pl_error_mensaje: We are sorry. {{app}} has encountered a problem and cannot continue. You may review the error log and provide it to the developer.
pl_error_permisos_sistema: A Bluetooth permission is missing in the system. Please open the app settings and grant the Bluetooth and {{permiso}} permissions.
pl_login_descripcion: With {{app}} you can open your doors from your smartphone, with no keys or remote controls. Just get close to the device, tap the button for the door you want and wait a few seconds for it to respond.
pl_modo_demo: Demo mode: Bluetooth and devices are simulated. Change the name to leave it.
pl_permisos_mensaje: {{app}} needs Bluetooth and Location permissions to detect and connect automatically to your smart lock.
pl_pin_incorrecto_error: The PIN you entered is not correct.
pl_sin_dispositivo_mensaje: Look for your {{app}} to pair it and be able to open your door or garage.
pl_vinculacion_error_generico: Pairing error: it could not be completed. Please try again.
pl_vinculacion_error_mac: Pairing error: this device does not match your {{app}}.
pl_vinculando_ayuda: Pairing... If your smartphone asks for the Bluetooth PIN in a notification, enter it.
pl_vinculando_ayuda_simulacion: Pairing... If your smartphone asks for the Bluetooth PIN in a notification, enter {{pin}}.
pl_vincular_pin_mensaje: Enter the security PIN to pair this {{app}}.
pl_vincular_pin_mensaje_simulacion: Enter the security PIN ({{pin}}) to pair this {{app}}.
